title: Source inventory reader focus index
summary: This iteration adds a reader-facing static focus index to the full source inventory overview. The focus index surfaces configuration gaps, manual-maintained sources, disabled-source state, and platform bridge entries with counts, group links, and representative source samples while keeping all 154 registered source rows visible in the canonical fixed-order detail groups.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory reader focus lanes" tests/unit.test.js
node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory panel|source inventory navigation|source inventory density controls|source inventory reader focus lanes" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: A full fixed-order inventory still needs a small set of reader focus lanes for the slices people check first.
lessons.evidence: The source inventory overview now surfaces configuration gaps, manual-maintained sources, disabled-state rows, and platform bridge entries with counts, group anchors, and representative source names while preserving all 154 detail rows.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep focus lanes static and count-based unless a future interaction can prove it never removes canonical source rows from the DOM.

lessons.lesson: Markdown table adjacency can create a public layout regression even when data and tests are otherwise correct.
lessons.evidence: Visual inspection found the section-summary table separator rendering as body text after the focus table; the inventory overview now joins content blocks with blank lines and E2E checks reject leaked table separators.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding consecutive markdown tables, verify rendered HTML table count and scan for leaked `---` separator rows on desktop and mobile.

lessons.lesson: PowerShell stdin can mangle Chinese literals in ad hoc Node verification scripts.
lessons.evidence: Browser checks using direct Chinese literals returned false while E2E and Unicode-escaped checks passed; the final visual script used Unicode escapes for stable marker assertions.
lessons.recommended_action: Use Unicode escapes or file-based assertions for Chinese marker checks when piping scripts through PowerShell.

followups.action: If the full inventory remains hard to scan after user review, add an optional browser interaction for search/filtering that leaves the complete fixed-order source inventory in the DOM.
